title: Lighter chicken tikka masala
summary: A weeknight tikka masala built on yoghurt, tomatoes and a splash of light coconut milk instead of a jug of cream, with a measured portion of basmati.

steps.instruction: Stir the chicken with half the yoghurt, half the garam masala, the paprika, a pinch of salt and half the garlic. Set it aside. Rinse the rice.
steps.tip: Even a short sit in the yoghurt stops the chicken drying out in the pan.

steps.instruction: Boil the rice in the water with a pinch of salt, lid on, over a low heat for 10 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave it covered.

Warm the oil in the frying pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Stir in the remaining garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, cayenne and the rest of the garam masala for a minute until it smells fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes. Pour in the tomatoes, tomato purée and coconut milk, then simmer until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thick enough to coat a spoon.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the remaining yoghurt so it doesn't split. Taste for salt, scatter with coriander and serve with the rice.
